item.title: HSRD-100: 100 High-Quality 3D Human Scans for AI, Graphics & Research
item.description:
🧩 HSRD-100: 100 High-Quality 3D Human Scans for AI, Graphics & Research

Digital Reality Lab releases groundbreaking dataset for 3D human modeling and AI research

🚀 Introduction

We’re excited to introduce HSRD-100, a free dataset of 100 high-quality 3D human scans, released by Digital Reality Lab and hosted on Hugging Face.

It’s part of our growing collection on Hugging Face and the larger HumanScanRepository project — a professional library of 3D human data for AI, graphics, XR, and research.

📦 What’s inside HSRD-100

This comprehensive dataset offers unprecedented quality and detail for 3D human modeling:

  • 100 scans: 10 individuals × 10 unique poses
  • High-resolution photogrammetry: captured via a 112-camera rig
  • Multi-LOD meshes:
    • LOD0 ≈ 1 M polygons + 16 K textures - LOD1 ≈ 100 K polygons + 8 K textures
    • LOD2 ≈ 10 K polygons + 4 K textures
  • Metadata: person_meta.json, pose_meta.json, scan parameters, and file manifests
  • Source data: RealityCapture projects, photographic sets, and preview images
  • License: CC BY-4.0 — free for academic + commercial use (with attribution)

⚙️ Applications

The versatility of HSRD-100 opens doors to numerous cutting-edge applications:

  • AI & Computer Vision: pose estimation, reconstruction, segmentation, neural rendering
  • 3D Graphics & Avatars: realistic human base meshes for games, film, XR
  • Virtual Fashion: simulate garment fitting and cloth behavior on real human geometry
  • Education & Prototyping: compact dataset for universities and labs

⚠️ Limitations

While HSRD-100 demonstrates quality and balance, it’s a compact dataset:

  • Only 10 individuals → limited demographic diversity
  • 10 poses per subject → no extreme or dynamic motions
  • Captured in studio lighting → consistent but not “in-the-wild”

For large-scale ML or production research, use the full HumanScanRepository (20,000+ scans).

🛡️ Ethical Us

All subjects provided informed consent; no biometric identification or surveillance uses are permitted. Use responsibly under the CC BY-4.0 license with attribution to Digital Reality Lab.

✅ Final Thoughts

HSRD-100 represents a significant step forward in making high-quality 3D human data accessible to researchers, developers, and creators worldwide. While compact in scale, this dataset demonstrates the quality and potential of professional photogrammetry for AI and graphics applications. Whether you’re developing pose estimation algorithms, creating realistic avatars, or exploring virtual fashion, HSRD-100 provides a solid foundation with ethical data collection practices and open licensing.

For those requiring larger-scale datasets, the full HumanScanRepository offers thousands of additional scans, making it suitable for production-level machine learning and comprehensive research projects.

item.title: HunyuanWorld-Mirror: Universal 3D World Reconstruction with Any-Prior Prompting
item.description:
🌍 HunyuanWorld-Mirror: Universal 3D World Reconstruction with Any-Prior Prompting

Revolutionary 3D reconstruction model from Tencent that transforms any image into comprehensive 3D representations

[](https://github.com/tencent/Huny uanWorld-Mirror)

🚀 Revolutionary 3D Reconstruction Technology

HunyuanWorld-Mirror represents a groundbreaking advancement in 3D computer vision, offering a versatile feed-forward model for comprehensive 3D geometric prediction. This innovative system integrates diverse geometric priors and simultaneously generates multiple 3D representations in a single forward pass, making it a game-changer for developers and researchers working with 3D reconstruction tasks.

⚡ Key Capabilities

The model seamlessly integrates various geometric inputs:

  • Camera poses 📸
  • Calibrated intrinsics 🔍
  • Depth maps 📏

And generates comprehensive 3D outputs:

  • Point clouds ☁️
  • Multi-view depths 🌐
  • Camera parameters 📐
  • Surface normals 📊
  • 3D Gaussians 🧩

🏗️ Architecture Overvie

Unified architecture handling the full spectrum of 3D reconstruction tasks

HunyuanWorld-Mirror’s architecture consists of two fundamental components that work in harmony:

🔧 (1) Multi-Modal Prior Prompting

This sophisticated mechanism embeds diverse prior modalities into the feed-forward model. The system intelligently processes:

  • Calibrated intrinsics for precise camera modeling
  • Camera pose information for spatial understanding
  • Depth data for geometric context

Given any subset of available priors, the model utilizes several lightweight encoding layers to convert each modality into structured tokens, ensuring maximum flexibility and adaptability.

🎯 (2) Universal Geometric Prediction

A unified architecture capable of handling the complete spectrum of 3D reconstruction tasks:

  • Camera and depth estimation
  • Point map regression
  • Surface normal estimation
  • Novel view synthesis
  • Multi-view geometry prediction

This comprehensive approach eliminates the need for multiple specialized models, streamlining workflows and reducing computational overhead.

💡 Technical Innovation

🔄 Single Forward Pass Efficiency

Unlike traditional approaches that require multiple processing stages, HunyuanWorld-Mirror generates all 3D representations simultaneously. This revolutionary efficiency makes real-time applications feasible and significantly reduces processing time.

🧠 Adaptive Prior Integration

The model’s ability to work with partial prior information sets it apart from competitors. Whether you have complete camera calibration data or just basic depth information, HunyuanWorld-Mirror adapts intelligently to deliver optimal results.

🌟 Multi-Format Output Support

The system’s versatility shines through its ability to generate various 3D representation formats, making it compatible with different downstream applications and rendering pipelines.

🎯 Use Cases and Applications

  • Real-time 3D scene generation from concept art
  • Asset creation for virtual worlds
  • Interactive environment reconstruction

🏢 Architecture and Design

  • Building information modeling (BIM)
  • Site planning and visualization
  • Heritage preservation and documentation

🚗 Autonomous Systems

  • Environment mapping for self-driving vehicles
  • Robotic navigation and path planning
  • Augmented reality applications

🎬 Media and Content Creation

  • Film and animation asset generation
  • Virtual production environments
  • Social media AR filters and effects

Its ability to handle diverse input priors while generating comprehensive 3D representations in a single forward pass makes it an invaluable tool for researchers, developers, and creators working with 3D content. The model’s adaptive architecture and multi-format output support position it as a cornerstone technology for future 3D applications across gaming, architecture, autonomous systems, and content creation industries.

The significant community adoption (12,512+ downloads last month) and strong research foundation demonstrate its practical value and potential for widespread implementation. As 3D content becomes increasingly central to digital experiences, HunyuanWorld-Mirror provides the robust, flexible foundation needed to power next-generation applications.
